description: Validate an es-plus JSON configuration against its schema. Returns validation errors and fix suggestions. READ-ONLY: it judges and never repairs — format mistakes that the generators auto-fix (key aliases, relocated/nested keys, null placeholders, 'false'-style string booleans, dialog shorthands like dialogs:["add"]) are reported here as errors. Use this to inspect a config; the generator tools repair such mistakes before generating (they report each repair).

config.description: JSON string of the es-plus configuration to validate

type.description: Schema type to validate against. Available: api-params, btn-config, dialog-options, form-item, table-column, table-options, structured-crud-config (the input of generate_crud_from_config), es-table-config / es-form-config / es-dialog-config (the inputs of generate_table / generate_form / generate_dialog). Defaults to "form-item".

name: validate_config
